notes:
What’s new in DriveDeck 0.20.3

• Phone dashboard: safer reconnects after stopping or reopening, a saved connection address, clearer connection screens, and fewer unnecessary requests.
• Mobile fullscreen: thicker black bars at the top and bottom, with content kept clear of camera cutouts, the Dynamic Island and the home indicator.
• Martin: larger mobile gauges and center display, improved tablet gauge alignment, and more space for maps and music on wide displays.
• Album colors now favor prominent, distinctive colors. Near-black tones become muted gray so they remain visible on dark dashboards and visualizers.
• Added the supplied vehicle image pack to Martin’s tire-pressure display and Model S/Three driving views, with improved vehicle variant detection.
• Phone pairing now displays one QR code with a network-address selector.

After updating, start the phone dashboard, scan its QR code and replace your old Home Screen shortcut once. Keep DriveDeck open on your PC. Reinstall the bundled BeamNG companion and restart the game for the updated vehicle variant detection. Existing settings are preserved.
